scientific_integrity: Finite exhaustive enumeration with complete standalone Python 3 and C++17 sources; direct prefix/suffix and independent centered-height predicates agree on every tested primitive word.
scientific_limitations: Complete only through length 16 and at the first possible length; no all-length counting formula is claimed.
The existence of a length-16 example is already covered by the construction of Charlier et al. (2015); only sharpness and the full six-necklace classification are put forward.
The full 2014 Christodoulakis et al. article was not retrieved, and exhaustive historical-priority determination is not claimed.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp first length and six necklaces for primitive binary words with no Abelian-unbordered conjugate
